name: gap133-arc
description: Live, verified price gaps between Polymarket/Limitless and Kalshi. Free sample, or 1 cent in USDC on Arc per live answer, signature-checked.
long_description:
gap133 finds the same prediction-market event priced differently on Polymarket or Limitless and on Kalshi, and shows the gap before and after fees.

Free tools: a 10-minute-delayed sample and on-chain usage stats work with no setup.

Paid tool: add the private key of a small, dedicated spending wallet holding about $1 of USDC on Arc mainnet. Each live answer costs 0.01 USDC, paid automatically. Before paying, the extension checks it is paying the official gap133 contract at the on-chain price, and it stops at the spending limit you set. Every answer is signature-checked against the attester stored in that contract.

The key is stored by Claude Desktop in your system keychain and never leaves your computer. Use a wallet made just for this, never your main one.

Market data only, not trading advice.

agent_key.title: Spending wallet private key (optional)
agent_key.description: Only needed for live paid answers. Use a NEW wallet made just for this, holding about $1 of USDC on Arc mainnet. Stored in your system keychain. Leave empty to use the free tools only.

max_spend_usdc.title: Spending limit per session (USDC)
max_spend_usdc.description: The extension stops paying once it has spent this much since Claude Desktop started. 0.10 means up to 10 live answers.
